  <h1 class="title">aj-starter-gold</h1>
  <p class="dek">A type-safe, isomorphic TypeScript starter combining Angular and NestJS into one three-tier architecture.</p>

  <h2 class="h2">Why</h2>
  <p>I wanted a working reference for combining Angular and NestJS into a single three-tier system that shares real types across the client and server, instead of maintaining the same model twice in two languages or two disconnected TypeScript codebases.</p>

  <h2 class="h2">How it works</h2>
  <p>Angular on the frontend, NestJS on the backend, both TypeScript, with a shared type layer between them so a model change is a compiler error on both ends, not a runtime surprise on one.</p>

  <h2 class="h2">What I learned</h2>
  <p>The hard part isn't the code, it's the configuration &mdash; getting the build tooling, module boundaries, and shared types to agree so the two halves behave like one system instead of two projects glued together.</p>

  <h2 class="h2">Code</h2>
  <p class="mono-link"><a href="https://github.com/alexanderwiebe/aj-starter-gold">github.com/alexanderwiebe/aj-starter-gold</a></p>
</div>
